title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 28, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 378 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Things are pretty calm. ✨

Solar images show a broad dark coronal region and several bright EUV areas, with no obvious large outward structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
